climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
building_stock: The Seddon-specific records evidence the state of existing door hardware rather than building era, and it splits two ways — one Seddon West VIC request is for a door with no deadbolt provision at all ("I just bought a smart lock and want to install it on my door. The door doesn't have a deadbolt hole", alongside "Door handle to be changed to have a lock"), while another Seddon West VIC job describes a "Lockwood Double Cylinder 355 Deadlock" that is "brand new and installed by a local locksmith", and the Precision Locksmiths Seddon page records a job covering both "a mechanical gate lock and digital front door lock" — so quoting here has to distinguish boring a fresh deadbolt bore from a like-for-like swap onto a recent Lockwood 355, and check whether a separate street gate lock forms part of the same entry.
demographic_skew: The returned records evidence no demographic composition for Seddon, but they do consistently show a self-supplying buyer — the Seddon West requester had already purchased the lock and said "I can manage the technology side", wanting only the mechanical fit, and a second Seddon West job was "just adding the smart lock for extra security" over already-sound hardware — so local demand skews toward labour-only fitting of resident-sourced locks rather than supply-and-install packages.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be fitted to a door that has no deadbolt bore, and what that involves — the Airtasker Seddon West VIC lock-installation listing states "I just bought a smart lock and want to install it on my door. The door doesn't have a deadbolt hole", with a companion request that a "Door handle to be changed to have a lock".
Getting only the physical fitting done, having already bought the lock and intending to do the pairing themselves — the same Seddon West VIC requester adds "I can manage the technology side".

Whether a smart lock can be added as a second layer alongside existing hardware that is still new, rather than replacing it — the Airtasker Seddon West VIC locksmith listing describes "just adding the smart lock for extra security" where the existing lock "is a Lockwood Double Cylinder 355 Deadlock - it's brand new and installed by a local locksmith".

Which digital lock model to choose, and whether a front gate lock can be handled in the same visit — the Precision Locksmiths Seddon page carries a customer account of seeking "advice on a mechanical gate lock and digital front door lock" who "subsequently opted to go with the Dahua Digital Smart lock after Dave's recommendation, which he fitted today".
